comparison_projection.purpose: Flatten perspective for elevation-like vegetation object comparisons

objects.title: Courtyard Canopy Tree
objects.design_intent: A broad, layered courtyard shade tree with a tapered trunk, explicit branch junctions, swept limbs, foliage lobes, and individually modeled leaves.

objects.title: Sculptural L-System Tree
objects.design_intent: A narrow architectural tree whose deterministic L-system crown is supported by a visible warm-timber trunk and clipped cloud foliage.

objects.title: Layered Flowering Plant Cluster
objects.design_intent: A modern rectangular planter containing deterministic flowering herbs, scattered grass underplanting, modeled leaves, petals, soil, and drainage feet.

objects.title: Wall-Climbing Ivy Privacy Screen
objects.design_intent: A freestanding slatted privacy screen with deterministic wall-seeking ivy, offset attachment behavior, a planted trough, and visible support feet.

objects.title: Tendril Pergola Vine
objects.design_intent: A compact pergola bay with twining tendril vines, branching overhead growth, leaf blades, and flowering petals around a clear structural frame.
